svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TransformMyNotes system architecture
svg.desc: Clients (marketing browser, authed browser, Android app) reach a single Cloudflare-DNS-fronted CloudFront Router that splits traffic to two Next.js apps: public Marketing and authed Application. Application is protected by AWS Cognito auth and shares the core library with background jobs. Data lives in a DynamoDB single-table design (Notes table with GSI1-GSI9, plus UserData, Invites, Groups, Usage, StudyEvents) and an S3 bucket. DynamoDB Streams trigger Lambda consumers for async study-set generation, source extraction, and usage/progress aggregation, plus two daily crons. Amazon Bedrock, Polly, Resend and Cloudflare Turnstile are external managed services. GitHub Actions deploys via OIDC to AWS.
svg.text: Next.js on SST v4 / AWS · DynamoDB single-table design · event-driven jobs · Amazon Bedrock AI
